title: PIGSTI: a modular, reproducible pipeline for host identification and detection of ancient pathogens and zoonotic microbes in animal palaeogenomic data
description: Snakemake pipeline for ancient DNA pathogen screening: host/mtDNA mapping, KrakenUniq metagenomics, optional HOPS/decOM, pathogen reference mapping, and multi-criteria authentication with cohort Excel/PDF deliverables.
